title: Incident on the Kalka Mail
subtitle: Snowfall, Secrets, and a Midnight Train Mystery
summary: When famed detective Feluda is approached by a wealthy and enigmatic client, an ordinary March morning quickly transforms into a journey shrouded in intrigue and danger. Set against a stunning wintry backdrop, Feluda must unravel secrets concealed within the Kalka Mail and outwit a cunning adversary. Embark on an unforgettable adventure where every clue could be a matter of life or death.
